figures.title: Figure 1
figures.llm_description: FIG. 1: Spin and polarization waves in a canted multiferroic, such as a BiFeO3 film. The sublattice magnetizations M1, M2 lie in the plane perpendicular to the FE polarization P . Fluctuations δP denote polar phonons associated to vibra-tions of the FE moment. (a) Depicts the low frequency (soft) spin wave mode. (b) High-frequency (gapped) mode. The dots in the circle denote the position of the spins one quarter cycle later. figures.llm_description: FIG. 2: (a) Low frequency magnetostatic spin wave dispersion for a BiFeO3 film, for propagation angles θ = 0◦(propagation along the electric polarization direction ˆz), 10◦, 30◦, 60◦, 90◦ (propagation along the N´eel direction ˆy).
